description: Phase 2 g0 mitigation microcampaign using dynamical decoupling and Pauli/measurement twirling.
rationale: The Phase 2 layout seed search did not improve g0 k=2 on hardware.
IBM Runtime Sampler supports dynamical decoupling and twirling options for noise management.
This microcampaign repeats only g0 k=0 and g0 k=2, the sensitive calibration pair.
The compilation seed is reset to the accepted Phase 1 g0 repeat seed 12345, so the experimental variable is mitigation rather than layout randomization.

selected_jobs.purpose: Test whether Runtime-level DD and twirling reduce the residual g0 k=2 bias.

stopping_rules: Prepare without --submit and confirm the base circuit matches the accepted Phase 1 opt2 depth profile.
If mitigation does not improve g0 k=2, stop QPU spending on g0 and document it as a noise-sensitive calibration case.
